routing.title: Qualified lead routing
routing.description: When the AI qualifies a lead (operation, area and budget), the first active matching rule assigns the conversation to an agent or, for a team, in turns.
routing.deleteConfirm: Delete the rule “{name}”? Leads already assigned don't change.
routing.empty: No rules yet. Without rules, qualified leads stay with whoever handles the conversation.
routing.adminOnly: Only admins can change the rules.
routing.help: Rules are checked top to bottom; the first match wins. Only conversations without an owner are assigned.
routing.dialogHint: Leave a condition empty to not filter by it.
routing.name: Rule name
routing.conditionsHelp: The lead must meet every condition set. The budget matches when its range overlaps the rule's.
routing.noTeams: No teams — create them in Settings › Teams
routing.teamHelp: Goes to the available team member who has waited longest for a conversation.

errors.name_required: Enter a name for the rule
errors.target_required: Choose a team or an agent
errors.invalid_member: That agent is no longer an active member

panel.title: Lead profile

panel.scoreHelp: Score: profile completeness, budget, financing, move-in timeframe and engagement
panel.matchesNeedProfile: Set an operation or area to see matching listings.
